Hard Contact'' |author=[[Karen Traviss]]''[[Republic Commando: Hard Contact]]'' |cover artist=[[Greg Knight]] |illustrator= |editor= |publisher=[[Del Rey]] |early release= |release date=[[October 26]], [[2004]]{{SWArchive|url=eu/lit/novel/f20041022/index.html|text=Giving Commandos a Human Side: Author Karen Traviss}} |intl release= |rereleased= |media type=Paperback |pages=293 |isbn=9780345478276 |isbn2= |isbn3= |timeline=[[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' |series=''[[Republic Commando]]'' |preceded by="[[The League of Spies]]" |followed by="[[Omega Squad: Targets]]" }} '''''Republic Commando: Hard Contact''''' is a 293-page tie-in novel to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Republic Commando]]'' and the first novel in the [[Republic Commando|''Republic Commando'' series]]. The book, written by [[Karen Traviss]] and published by [[Del Rey]] on [[October]] [[October 26|26]], [[2004]], is set in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] during the [[Rise of the Empire era]]. It tells the story of a [[Omega Squad|squad]] of [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] on a mission to destroy a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Bioweapon/Legends|bioweapons]] lab on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Qiilura/Legends|Qiilura]]. The commandos ([[Niner Skirata|Niner]], [[Fi Skirata|Fi]], [[Atin Skirata|Atin]], and [[Darman Skirata|Darman]]) are aided by the [[Gurlanin]]s [[Jinart]] and [[Valaqil]], along with an inexperienced [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] named [[Etain Tur-Mukan]] and a Weequay named Guta-Nay.
